collectorStatement: I collect work where AI is genuinely the medium — custom-trained models, artist-built datasets, deliberate latent-space exploration, and human-machine collaboration with a clear authorial hand. The interesting question is always authorship: I want to feel the artist steering the model, not the model steering the artist.
avoid: Generic prompt outputs, trend-chasing AI aesthetics, style mimicry of existing artists, and work where the model made all the decisions.
